data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): Add explicit _VALID_COMBINATIONS frozenset enumerating all valid (direction, action) pairs; add parametrized test test_invalid_direction_action_combinations_raise covering all INVALID pairs (not just clean_label and repair_property). Clarify Mutation.target: str field carries jira_key for inbound, local_id for outbound. Add docstring on Mutation dataclass + MutationAction enum stating canonical action taxonomy. Specific test names: test_mutation_invalid_direction_action_combination_raises_value_error (parametrized), test_mutation_is_frozen_hashable, test_action_enum_membership_exact.
